title: Vedio editor
description:
**About the Company**

**HospitalStore.com**, a division of **Medsun Biomedical Technologies**, is building a simpler way to buy medical equipment and healthcare products.

We are looking for a creative and hands\-on **Video Editor \& Content Creator** who can transform ideas into clear, engaging, and professional video content around medical equipment, hospital technology, product explainers, comparisons, and real\-world healthcare topics.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Edit **YouTube videos, Instagram Reels, and Shorts**, including product videos, explainers, and educational content.
* Convert ideas and concepts into **simple scripts, storyboards, and engaging video content**.
* Handle basic **camera setup, framing, lighting, and shooting** when required.
* Create **motion graphics, text animations, transitions, product visuals, and other video elements**.
* Manage **sound design, music, sound effects, color correction, and overall video quality**.
* Create AI\-generated **visuals and B\-roll** using tools such as Kling, Runway, Midjourney, or similar AI platforms.
* Collaborate with the **Content and Marketing teams** to develop new video ideas and concepts.
* Manage the complete video production process from **shooting to editing and final export**.
* Ensure videos are optimized for different platforms and maintain consistent quality and branding.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* **2–3 years of practical experience** in video editing and content creation.
* Strong portfolio showcasing **YouTube videos, Reels, and Shorts**.
* Proficiency in **Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects**.
* Working knowledge of **CapCut or similar tools** for quick social media edits.
* Good understanding of **camera angles, framing, lighting, lenses, and composition**.
* Strong understanding of **video pacing, storytelling, music, sound effects, and text placement**.
* Basic experience with **AI video/image generation tools** is an added advantage.
* Creative mindset with good attention to detail and visual quality.
* Ability to work independently, take feedback positively, and improve the final output.
* Good communication and coordination skills.

**What We’re Looking For**

We need someone who is not only a good video editor but can also **understand an idea, suggest creative improvements, shoot when required, and take ownership of the complete video production process**.

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

**Monotype (Global)**


Named "One of the Most Innovative Companies in Design" by Fast Company, Monotype brings brands to life through type and technology that consumers engage with every day. The company's rich legacy includes a library that can be traced back hundreds of years, featuring famed typefaces like Helvetica,


Futura, Times New Roman and more. Monotype also provides a first\-of\-its\-kind service that makes fonts more accessible for creative professionals to discover, license, and use in our increasingly digital world. We work with the biggest global brands, and with individual creatives, offering a wide set of solutions that make it easier for them to do what they do best: design beautiful brand experiences.

 **Monotype Solutions India**  

Monotype Solutions India is a strategic center of excellence for Monotype and is a certified Great Place to Work® three years in a row. The focus of this fast\-growing center spans Product Development, Product Management, Experience Design, User Research, Market Intelligence, Research in areas of Artificial Intelligence and Machine learning, Innovation, Customer Success, Enterprise Business Solutions, and Sales.  

Headquartered in the Boston area of the United States and with offices across 4 continents, Monotype is the world’s leading company in fonts. It’s a trusted partner to the world’s top brands and was named “One of the Most Innovative Companies in Design” by Fast Company.


Monotype brings brands to life through the type and technology that consumers engage with every day. Monotype also provides a first\-of\-its\-kind service that makes fonts more accessible for creative professionals to discover, license, and use in our increasingly digital world. We work with the biggest global brands, and with individual creatives, offering a wide set of solutions that make it easier for them to do what they do best: design beautiful brand experiences.


The associate will perform marketing and technical research into prospective and current customers including, but not limited to, the review of websites, mobile applications, electronic documents, and digital ads. Working closely with Monotype Imaging Inc.’s Legal team, the Research Associate will organize and  

maintain research files and prepare reports documenting issues of infringement or potential licensing gaps for Monotype Imaging Inc.’s and/or its partners’ intellectual property.

**You will have an opportunity to:**

* Conduct brand marketing research.
* Identify digital offerings across all applicable mediums (e.g. mobile applications, websites, digital ads, online marketing materials, etc.)
* Download and review digital assets using a variety of software applications.
* Conduct forensic investigation of IP infringement matters, including technical analysis of hardware and software containing fonts.
* Organize and maintain research files using G\-Suite applications.
* Communicate results with Legal team in a timely fashion.
* Preparation and reporting of statistical data regarding brand font use audits.

* Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS \& JS
* Strong analytical skills
* Proficiency in Microsoft \& Google Office products
* Quick Learner
* Strong communication skills and team player
